### Career at Posterity Group

I did my 16-month engineering coop at Posterity Group, where I got to learn about long-term forecasting and demand side management. I was nominated for coop student of the year by my supervisor.
The first project I got to work on was developing a power bi dashboard for the city of Edmonton.
I then got to work as a main on two projects for FortisBC, one of which doubled in budget due to our success. 
To see more of Posterity Group's work, check out their website: [PG-Web](https://www.posteritygroup.ca/)
